name: padlet
description: Official Padlet plugin. Connects the agent to Padlet's hosted MCP server and adds teacher skills for lesson boards, exit tickets, feedback on student posts, weekly digests, remakes, and attachments. Sign in with your own Padlet account — no API keys.

interface.shortDescription: Build and run class boards in Padlet
interface.longDescription: Read, search, create, and edit padlets and posts through Padlet's hosted MCP server. Includes teacher skills to build a lesson board from a lesson plan, summarise exit tickets and misconceptions, draft feedback on student posts for your approval, write a weekly class digest, remake a board for a new class, and attach files. Every action runs as you, within Padlet's own permissions.
defaultPrompt: Turn this lesson plan into a Padlet board for my class.
Summarise the exit tickets on my latest padlet and list the misconceptions.
Draft feedback on the student posts on my padlet — show me before posting.
